decisions.decision: Adapter resource pattern over query rewrite
decisions.rationale: Prototype uses 4 Resources (ShieldState/IntegrityState/CapacitorState/HeatState); real game has ShipStats Component + ComboHeatSystem Resource. Adapter is one trivial file vs rewriting every bind_*_to_wheel system

decisions.decision: in_triglavian_invasion / not_in_triglavian_invasion run conditions over feature flags
decisions.rationale: Mirrors existing not_last_stand pattern at src/ui/hud/mod.rs:85; evaluates ActiveModule.module_id every frame; no JSON parsing or compile-time branching

decisions.decision: FactionSkin as single Resource with is_changed() listener
decisions.rationale: update_faction_materials listens on is_changed() and re-tints every material asset in one pass; sync_faction_skin_from_active_module writes only when target differs from current

decisions.decision: Drop Deployable slot for Triglavian (5 slots, not 6)
decisions.rationale: TriglavianShips have no deployable capability; keeping the slot would require a no-op stub. Also fixes the prototype's compact-mode stacking bug (Ability/Deployable shared coords) by construction
decisions.reversible: no — slot count is layout.rs contract

decisions.decision: Test mirror over full plugin import
decisions.rationale: TriglavianInvasionPlugin::spawn_trig_wave requires a Window entity the headless app doesn't provide. Mirroring production wiring in build_triglavian_campaign_app decouples HUD tests from campaign simulation
cargo fmt produced 40+ file diffs across unrelated modules. Mixing with Combat Wheel feature would obscure both in git log and risk bisect breaks
